title: Notification regarding Full Bench on 20th , August 2026 at 2 P.M.
text:
KEY LINES:
Singh and Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 20-08-2026 at 2:00 pm. only for hearing

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 17th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar and
litigants that there will be a Full Bench of Hon’ble The Chief Justice, Hon'ble Mr, Justice A. Bimol
Singh and Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 20-08-2026 at 2:00 pm. only for hearing
the following matters:-
i) W.P,(Cril.) No. 19 of 2008 [ VOJ Shyama Devi Us. D,M., Imphal West & 3 Ors.] and
its connected matters; &
it) W.A. No. 46 of 2018 [State of Manipur Us. RV Ramlung\ and its connected matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
\Ic REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ / S'/3–gi Imphal, the 17th August, 2026
